title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Serious About God and Still Fun to Be Around
caption:
Holy was never meant to be heavy. A man who is serious about God can laugh, listen, and show up to the cookout without turning it into a sermon.

Which one do you need to work on? Send this to the friend who's the most fun and the most faithful.

#faith #godlyman #joy #brotherhood #christianmen
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
